summary: Tecnoglass filed an 8-K to announce a routine quarterly cash dividend of $0.15 per share for Q2 2026, payable July 31, 2026 to holders of record June 30, 2026. The filing contains no acquisition, divestiture, activist, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return (beyond normal dividend), spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or forced management change. It is a standard dividend declaration with no special-situation implications. The press release is attached as Exhibit 99.1. No unusual terms, advisors, or risk-arb angle; simply a regular dividend event.
